definitions.short: (only in plural collective or emphatic form) youth , the state ( juvenility ) or the persons ( young people)
definitions.full: H5271. naur נְעוּרִים noun [masculine] plural youth, early life ; — absolute ׳נ Isa 54:6 ; Psa 127:4 ; elsewhere suffix נְעֻרַי 1Sam 12:2 , נְעוּרַי Job 31:18 +, נְעֻרֶיךָ 2Sam 19:8 , נְעוּרֶיךָ Prov 5:18 +, נְעוּרַיִךְ Jer 2:2 +, נְעוּרָ֑יְכִי Psa 103:5 , נְעוּרֵיהֶן Ezek 23:3 , etc.; — youth, early life , especially in phrase ׳מִנּ from one's youth up Gen 8:21 (J), 1Sam 17:33 ; 1Kin 18:12 ; Jer 3:24 ; Zech 13:5 ; Job 31:18 (extreme youth; || אִמִּי מִבֶּטֶן ); figurative of Babylon Isa 47:12 , 15 , Moab Jer 48:11 , Judah 22:21 compare Psa 71:5 ; 71:17 ; 129:1 ; 129:2 ; ׳מִנּ וְעַדעַֿתָּה Gen 46:34 (J), 2Sam 19:8 ; Ezek 4:14 ; ׳מִנּ הַזֶּה וְעַדהַֿיּוֺם 1Sam 12:2 ; Jer 3:25 ; as time in or during which Lev 22:13 (H), Num 30:4 ; Numbers 30:17 (P), Lam 3:27 ; Psa 144:12 , figurative of Judah and Samaria, personified, Ezek 23:2 , 8 ; compare נ ׳יְמֵי (in figurative of Israel) Hosea 2:17 (|| מִצְרָ֑יִם מֵאֶרֶץ עֲלוֺתָהּ יוֺם ), Ezek 16:22 , 43 , 60 ; 23:19 ; other phrase are: נ ׳אַלּוּף Jer 3:4 friend of my youth , compare Prov 2:17 , נ ׳עֲוֺנוֺת Job 13:26 , נ ׳חַטּאֹות Psa 25:7 , נ ׳חֶסֶד Jer 2:2 , נ ׳חֶרְמַּת 31:19 , נ ׳זִמַּת Ezek 23:21 , נ ׳שְׁדֵי 23:21 , נ ׳בַּעַל Joel 1:8 , and especially נ ׳אֵשֶׁת Prov 5:18 ; Mal 2:14-15 , Isa 54:6 (figurative); נ ׳בְּנֵי Psa 127:4 sons of (a man's) youth ; = youthful vigour 103:5 . [ נְעוּרוֺת ] noun [feminine] plural id.; — only מִנְּעֻרֹתֵיהֶם Jer 32:30 (figurative of nation).
definitions.rootNote: or נָעֻר ; and (feminine) נְעֻרָה ; properly, passive participle from 5288 as denominative;
